checks.name: survivor-pump-starts-any
checks.why: Mirrors lib/subagents/slots.ts:89 without the `state !== "queued"` drop. No path in the model leaves a child in line in another state: a stop takes it out of line (team.ts:412), and every other writer that leaves queued (start, go) takes it out first. The guard is for asking and waiting children, which the model leaves out.
